$comment: Files in src/app allowed to differ from apps/web/src (or to have no web counterpart). One entry per file or glob, relative to src/app. category: platform (a platform service is the reason), native-editor (the native editor is), desktop-only (a screen or tool web has no counterpart for). reason: why, in a sentence. Kit-API drift (onPress, testID, lists, dialogs) is never a reason: phase 4 removes it.

entries.reason: Assets (icons, illustrations, SVG and raster images) generated by tools/gen-assets.mjs, since the GPUI host cannot import asset files the way web's Vite build does.
Smoke screen that exercises every @platform service on the native host; web has no such screen.
Standalone status screen root.tsx shows for the boot/demo mode of the native host; web has no such screen.
Developer benchmarks for the native host (attachment I/O), not part of the app.
Actions the native editor asks its host for (links, attachments, previews); Tiptap does these inside the web editor.
Binds the native editor's host actions to the app's stores and attachment helpers; web's Tiptap editor has no host bridge.
The bug report link opens with the shell service (shell.openUrl); web calls window.open, which the desktop host does not have. Otherwise identical to web.
